entities.summary: Ronaldo Rogério de Freitas Mourão was a Brazilian astronomer and the founder of the Museum of Astronomy and Related Sciences (MAST), as well as a researcher and titular partner at the Brazilian History and Geography Institute (IGHB). He was born and died in Rio de Janeiro.
